points.quote: If your assignment guidelines forbid AI, don’t use it.
points.gist: Do not use AI if your assignment guidelines forbid it.

points.quote: If AI use is allowed, explain how you used it in your work.
points.gist: Where AI use is allowed, explain how you used it in your work.

points.quote: Never share personal, confidential, or copyrighted material with public AI tools.
points.gist: Never share personal, confidential or copyrighted material with public AI tools.

points.quote: Respect copyright — don’t upload university materials like lecture slides or readings.
points.gist: Do not upload university materials such as lecture slides or readings.

points.quote: Acknowledge your use of AI (for example, “I used Microsoft Copilot to help check grammar in my essay”).
points.gist: Acknowledge AI use, for example by stating you used Microsoft Copilot to help check grammar in an essay.

points.quote: The School of Health and Life Sciences provide help on filling in the Declaration of the Use of AI form for modules on p5-6 of their student guidance
points.gist: The School of Health and Life Sciences has a Declaration of the Use of AI form, with help on pages 5-6 of its student guidance.

points.quote: Never cite AI as an author — cite original materials.
points.gist: Never cite AI as an author; cite the original materials.

points.quote: Cite directly included AI content using Teesside University’s referencing guide.
points.gist: Cite directly included AI content using the university's referencing guide.

points.quote: Always check facts and accuracy using trusted academic sources (books, journals, library databases).
points.gist: Always check facts and accuracy against trusted academic sources such as books, journals and library databases.

points.quote: Avoid letting AI think for you (“cognitive offloading”).
points.gist: Avoid letting AI think for you, known as cognitive offloading.

points.quote: Be aware of environmental impact. Each AI query uses energy. Combine your questions into one well-thought-out prompt to reduce your digital footprint.
points.gist: Each AI query uses energy, so combine your questions into one well-thought-out prompt to reduce your digital footprint.

points.quote: At Teesside University, we encourage users to apply the CRAFT model when writing prompts.
points.gist: Users are encouraged to apply the CRAFT model when writing prompts.

points.quote: In order to avoid academic misconduct, you should be evidencing the search that you have undertaken to find the resources to support your assignment and bibliography.
points.gist: To avoid academic misconduct, evidence the search you undertook to find resources for your assignment and bibliography.

points.quote: You should also keep all the updated drafts of your work to evidence changes that you have made.
points.gist: Keep all updated drafts of your work to evidence the changes you made.

points.quote: A Blackboard module on AI is available to Teesside University students. Login to Blackboard, go to Organisations and then The AI Resilient Learner
points.gist: A Blackboard module called The AI Resilient Learner is available under Organisations.
